evidence.C1: No mention of style guides or coding conventions
evidence.C2: No check for consistency with existing patterns beyond a brief KV alignment note
evidence.F1: Review restates scope but does not verify the change actually solves the stated problem
evidence.F2: Mentions edge cases such as null values or unexpected data types
evidence.F3: Recommends reviewing integration with other parts of the system to avoid unintended side effects
evidence.F4: No clear warning about breaking changes or impact on dependent code
evidence.M1: Questions whether validation location fits architecture and suggests a reusable function
evidence.M2: Does not flag PR scope as too large or suggest splitting
evidence.M3: No mention of public API or interface documentation
evidence.P1: No potential performance issues or inefficiencies identified
evidence.P2: No benchmarks or performance testing mentioned
evidence.Q1: Provides an overall summary in Scope and Impact sections
evidence.Q2: Review comments are anchored to specific file paths and line numbers
evidence.Q3: Does not distinguish between blocking issues and minor suggestions
evidence.Q4: Makes assertions rather than asking clarifying questions
evidence.Q5: Explains reasoning: code duplication reduces maintainability, insufficient tests miss edge cases
evidence.R1: Recommends refactoring validation logic into a separate reusable function
evidence.R2: Does not explicitly identify unnecessary complexity or suggest simplification
evidence.R3: No mention of code comments explaining the 'why'
evidence.S1: Discusses input validation logic and edge cases for invalid inputs
evidence.S2: No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or sensitive data flagged
evidence.S3: No assessment of error handling or failure recovery
evidence.T1: Discusses integration test coverage and recommends expanding test cases
evidence.T2: Suggests testing edge cases such as null values or unexpected data types
